**LEGAL NOTICE**  

*Date: 24‑10‑2026*  

---

**To,**  

Mr. [Name of the Addressee]  
[Flat/Room No.]  
[Building Name]  
[Street Address]  
New Delhi – [PIN Code]  

---  

**Subject:** *Demand for Recovery of Security Deposit of Rs. 10,000 (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) paid in respect of [address/property description]*  

---  

**1.** That the undersigned, Mr. [Your Name], residing at [Your Address], entered into a written tenancy/occupancy agreement (the “Agreement”) with you on [date] for the premises situated at [address of the premises].  

**2.** That as per Clause [‑] of the Agreement, the undersigned paid a security deposit of Rs. 10,000 (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) to you on [date of payment] to be held as security against any breach of the terms of the Agreement.  

**3.** That the tenancy/occupancy came to an end on [date of vacating] and the premises were vacated by the undersigned in a clean and good condition, and all obligations under the Agreement were duly performed by the undersigned.  

**4.** That despite repeated oral and written requests made on [list dates of reminders, if any], you have failed and refused to refund the security deposit of Rs. 10,000 to the undersigned.  

**5.** That the continued withholding of the security deposit amounts to a breach of the Agreement and entitles the undersigned to claim the said amount along with interest and compensation for the loss suffered, as provided under Section 73 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872.  

---  

**DEMAND / RELIEF**  

The undersigned hereby **demand** that you:

a) Refund the full security deposit of Rs. 10,000 (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) to the undersigned, **
